actionable_steps.citation: Cultivate Love And Become Divine — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 34 (2001), 2001-06-01
actionable_steps.step: Work for the welfare of society — repay your debt of gratitude for everything you have received from it.

actionable_steps.citation: Service to Society is Service to God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-11-23
actionable_steps.step: Treat service to society as service to God — it alone can confer peace on you.

actionable_steps.citation: Teaching values by example — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 20 (1987), 1987-09-26
actionable_steps.step: Cherish human values in daily life — a society without values will cease to be human.

actionable_steps.citation: Lessons on seva saadhana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 15 (1981 - 82), 1981-11-19
actionable_steps.step: Cooperate with others with spontaneity and pure intentions — that is the hallmark of true social living.

actionable_steps.citation: Develop Love for God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-18
actionable_steps.step: Put at least one principle of truth you have learnt into actual practice — society needs lived knowledge, not bookish heads.

definition.citation: Society, the Reality — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 11 (1971 - 72)
definition.quote: Society is the expansion and expression of the Divine in each of its components, denotable and enjoyable as One. Society is the awareness of this cognisible Divinity. … society is but God, who activates and prompts the composite whole.

discourses.citation: Lessons on seva saadhana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 15 (1981 - 82), 1981-11-19
discourses.quote: Society is the coming together of people. Cooperation among people in a society, motivated by spontaneity and by pure intentions, is the hall-mark of seva (service). … Society for man is like water for fish: if society rejects him or neglects him he cannot survive.

discourses.citation: Cultivate Love And Become Divine — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 34 (2001), 2001-06-01
discourses.quote: You are born and brought up in society. Then why do you not work for the welfare of society? All the wealth that you have earned has come from society. You should show your gratitude to society.

discourses.citation: Service to Society is Service to God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 39 (2006), 2006-11-23
discourses.quote: Serve society. Consider service to society as service to God. Service to society alone can confer peace on you.

discourses.citation: Develop Love for God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-18
discourses.quote: There can be no greater betrayal and ingratitude than not thinking of the welfare of society. Having been born in society, you should serve society. Your well-being is linked to the wellbeing of society.

make_it_real: Society is God wearing many faces — so the stranger you help today is Him in disguise.
title: Society
